goal: Turn approved source video into a scene-matched narrated or music-led vertical edit with reproducible voice choice and captions timed from actual audio.
source_requirements: owner-approved source or explicit reusable rights
source inventory covering scenes, faces, logos, burned-in text and usable segments
at least four meaningful visual beats for a narrated short
creative_contract: choose automatic, uploaded, music-only or silent mode explicitly
for automatic mode shortlist no more than three voices and approve a preview
map every narration sentence to a supporting source scene before synthesis
do not use narration to claim facilities, prices, availability or facts not visible or approved
preserve natural pacing; do not accelerate footage merely to fit the script
audio_contract: record provider, voice id, language, tone and rate
transcribe the actual final narration for caption timing
music remains subordinate to speech and the final narration-led mix targets about -16 LUFS
an unavailable selected voice blocks rather than silently switching provider
qa_contract: technical probe plus independent creative review
promotion_gate: one independent agent reproduction using only this recipe and its bounded packet
